value_labels.label: Employers in industry, commerce, etc. Persons who employ others in non-agricultural enterprises employing 25 or more persons
Managers in central and local government, industry, commerce, etc. Persons who generally plan and supervise in non-agricultural enterprises employing 25 or more persons
Employers in industry, commerce, etc. - small establishments. As in 11 but in establishments employing fewer than 25 persons.
Managers in industry, commerce, etc. - small establishments. As in 12 but in establishments employing fewer than 25 persons.
Professional workers - self employed. Self-employed person engaged in work normally requiring a university degree standard.
professional workers- employees. Employees engaged in work normally requiring a university degree standard.
Ancillary workers and artists. Employed and engaged with non-manual occupations not normally requiring qualifications of university degree standards; not employing others therein.
Foreman and supervisors non-manual. Employees (other than managers) engaged in occupations included in group 60, who formally and immediately supervise other engaged in such occupations.
Junior non-manual workers - Employees, not exercising general planning or supervisory powers,engaged in clerical, excl who have additional and formal supervisory functions (they are incl in group 52)
Personal service workers - Employees engaged in service occupations caring for food, drink, clothing or other professional needs.
Foreman and supervisors - manual. Employees (other than managers) who formally and immediately supervise other engaged in manual occupations whether or not themselves engaged in such occupations.
Skilled manual worker - Employees engaged in manual occupation which requires considerable and specific skills
Semi-skilled manual worker - Employees engaged in manual occupations which requires slightly but specific skills.
Unskilled manual workers - Other employees engaged in manual occupations
Own account workers  (Other than profnls). Self employed persons engaged in any trade, not normally required training or a university degree standard and have no emplys other than family workers.
Farmers - Employers and managers. Persons who own or rents farms, market gardens or forests, employing people other than family workers in the work of the enterprise.
Farmers - Own account. Persons who own or rents farms, market gardens or forests, having no employees than family workers.
Agricultural workers - Persons engaged and tending crops, animals, game, forests, or operating agricultural or forestry machinery
